column5: 门开后灯芯无火
column6: I push open the lantern room door; cold brass Fresnel lens on the right, salt-streaked windows behind it, unlit wick visible, Evan small at the left threshold.
column7: 我推开灯室的门。灯不转，也没有火。整座塔里，只有海风拍玻璃的声音。

column5: 埃文呼叫无人应答
column6: Medium from below the upper landing; Evan calls down the empty spiral stair from the open doorway, one palm on the worn iron railing.
column7: 我在楼梯口喊了一声，没人答应。我是来替班的，平常船还没靠稳，就有人下来接我的行李。这趟我是来接伊恩那一班的，值班簿上已经事先给我留好位置。

column5: 三件工作外套留在钩上
column6: Wide empty keeper quarters with exactly three working coats hung on iron pegs, chipped wash basin and the corner of three bunks.
column7: 三件上工的外套还挂着。靴架上留着一把钥匙，一推门就碰在碗边，响起来倒像有人坐在屋里。

column5: 寝室三张铺位空着
column6: Evan at the right side of the sleeping room checks passage between three narrow bunks, blankets turned back, no other occupant.
column7: 我连着找了三张铺，又绕到屋后。找不到人，也没见哪里像是闯进过生人。床头的杯子和书还在，门上也没有被撬开的痕迹。

column5: 船长指明外侧绕礁水路
column6: Wide from behind a mooring post: captain on deck points across the rough inlet and Evan at foreground landing follows his pointing hand; distant reef and open water are distinct.
column7: 船长说，夜里有条船要从岛外过。礁石就在那条航路旁边；塔上如果得停灯，他就开船去把那条船往外海领。那艘船以灯塔认岛，再从外海绕过去。船长把该走的那边指给我看。

column5: 两人用手灯约定联络
column6: Medium across gangway: gloved captain holds a hooded hand lantern, Evan has another, the two lamps clearly separate.
column7: 风大，栈桥上喊话都得贴着耳朵。我们干脆约了一组灯号，要他引船时，我就在塔上打给他。

column5: 埃文从库房找到存油
column6: Close detail service shelf: Evan navy sleeves steady the nearly dry lamp reservoir beside an unused oil tin, chipped enamel and worn timber, no face.
column7: 主灯油壶已经空了，库房却还有油。灯也没坏，只是再也没有人把油添进去。

column5: 值班桌放着三本私人日记
column6: Unoccupied duty desk from doorway; three separate closed clothbound journals in grey, brown and green, steel nib, salt on glass, leather bench edge.
column7: 值班室的桌上是值班簿，旁边有三本私人的日记。我认得那几个封皮，平时交班，没人会把它们混着拿。他们轮完夜班，还有点力气，就会在这里记一两句。

column5: 伊恩日记有首个异常日期
column6: Near top-down grey cloth journal opened on desk. One hand steadies blank warm paper; reserve left page readable, no glyphs.
column7: 最早那一页是伊恩的，十二月十四日。他写那晚轮到自己守灯，罗斯还在楼下。

column5: 从值班室可听到铁梯上的脚步
column6: Mid-distance upward view of the empty winding stair and closed lantern door, iron steps visibly connect the upper flight to the lower duty landing.
column7: 值班室往上只有一段铁梯。谁踩第一阶，灯室里就能听见，声音会顺着栏杆一直往上走。人要是真往回走，除非踮着脚，不然下面的人也会听见。

column5: 伊恩在灯亮时听见换班的三下
column6: Iain in grey waistcoat next to closed door, listening with a head tilt; active amber lens behind to the right and quiet paper on ledge.
column7: 那晚伊恩听见有人从下面上来。脚步停在门外，接着敲了三下，两下短的，最后一下拖得很长。

column5: 伊恩开门后梯上无人
column6: Iain framed at the top door looking downward, entire turn of stair below him empty, amber at threshold, cold iron steps.
column7: 这就是他们叫人换班的敲法。伊恩把门一开，铁梯上没人。下一段梯子也空着，连脚步下去的声音都没有。伊恩在门口等了一阵，以为是哪一级铁梯被风吹动了。

column5: 埃文摸到被风摇动的栏杆
column6: Evan tries a loose fixing on an old iron baluster beside a drafty stair window; familiar closed door above.
column7: 那天岛上风也大。我握住松动的栏杆，它就不响了。可放开以后，它只会乱晃，敲不出那个节奏。

column5: 第二本换班记录和首本日期相同
column6: Wide from across the empty duty desk, grey journal closed beside open brown leather journal, book bindings visible, no hands or people.
column7: 我翻了罗斯那一本。也是十二月十四日，写的也是伊恩在灯室、他上楼接班的那一晚。

column5: 罗斯本人照规矩来换班
column6: Ross in ochre vest one tread below lamp room door, knuckles poised to knock, white enamel mug in his other hand.
column7: 罗斯端着杯茶上楼，在门外敲完规规矩矩的三下。伊恩开门第一句话却是，刚才你回来过一次？

column5: 同一侧掉瓷的杯子同时可见
column6: Close detail of white blue-rimmed enamel mug in Ross's hand and visually identical duplicate on windowsill; triangular dark missing enamel at the same point, clear separation.
column7: 罗斯说没有。他刚想把茶放下，却看见窗边已经有一只杯子。杯口磕掉的一角，和他手里这只一模一样。

column5: 窗沿的额外杯子随光离开
column6: Medium from side of window, Ross draws his own mug against his chest; windowsill now empty, lens beam turned away.
column7: 等他再看，窗边那只已经不见了。自己的杯子还烫手。他把这一段记进日记，后面又划过一条线。那只杯子并没有被谁端走。罗斯说，他当时就守在窗边。

column5: 逐间搜完只有三人的冬季装备
column6: Wide seen through storage doorway with Evan offset left; exactly three sets of work gear on worn hooks, one narrow exit and no one hiding.
column7: 我那时想的是，有人趁交班躲进了塔里。我把能反锁的门都打开，三个人的东西倒是一件不缺。储藏间里吃的用的都点得上数，也不知道那个人会躲到哪儿去。

column5: 船长向埃文确认自己数到四人
column6: Medium dock exchange; grey-bearded captain facing Evan with raised four gloved fingers, lighthouse over shoulder across chipped railing.
column7: 我回栈桥问船长，前一趟来岛上送补给，他有没有见过生面孔。他说岸上没有，窗里倒多出来一个。

column5: 海上视角窗内恰好四道轮廓
column6: Dark boat rail at foreground, late nineteenth century stone lighthouse seen uphill from coastal water, a single lit lantern window with exactly four separated human silhouettes, no visible faces.
column7: 船刚开出去不远，船长顺着灯看回去，四道影子都挨着窗。石塔就这么一条梯，他没见第四个人出来。回去的路上，他还问过掌舵的人。对方只顾着看礁石，没往窗上看。

column5: 埃文把第三本的页面翻到海窗记录
column6: Evan angled beyond scratched desktop, green cloth journal opened next to previous two; lit oil desk lamp to one side.
column7: 剩下那本是安德鲁的。他资格最老，前面几页都在写风怎么刮、哪一扇窗该补，直到他写到透镜。

column5: 安德鲁和透镜中人动作不同时
column6: Andrew with one hand clearly flat at his side in real room, his image visibly lifting a mug inside right Fresnel glass only, stable pedestal and sea window.
column7: 他站在窗前没动，玻璃里那个穿他衣服的人，却先抬手拿杯。隔了一会儿，他才想起来自己的茶还在桌上。

column5: 岛上值班簿独立登记临时灯号
column6: Top-side detail old bound duty log and pen left on the table, rectangular blank ruled zone for graphic overlay, chimney soot on the oil lamp.
column7: 那晚他让伊恩把船灯怎么闪、什么时候闪，照着塔上的钟抄进值班簿，怕自己第二天说不明白。

column5: 船长交给埃文当晚的记时副页
column6: Close detail as salt-grey sleeve hands one period log copy across a tarred rail to a navy-sleeved hand, no letters and faces out of frame.
column7: 我找到船长那一晚的靠岛记录。船上的灯怎么闪，和塔里记的是同一组；两行落笔的时刻，却不一样。

column5: 两份旧记录显示塔上早七分钟
column6: Overhead two separate period note sheets with reserved blank spots aligned side by side for typeset times; no hand or person, ink blot and old steel nib.
column7: 先看见灯号的是灯塔，比船上早了七分钟。可是塔里的钟要是走错了，纸上的数字也会骗人。

column5: 两人天黑前在栈桥会合
column6: Wide dusk dock with vessel moored beyond worn gantry, Evan on wood landing and captain reaching from short gangway to compare watches.
column7: 天擦黑前，我又下了一趟栈桥。这一次我想让船长发一组新灯号，当天临时选，我不能事先知道。我请他把临时选出来的点数记进船簿，带着原页回来找我。

column5: 埃文怀表与船钟基准校准
column6: Detail two period timepieces close together held by contrasting sleeves, date-free and no legible numbers; hands in matching position, light unlettered.
column7: 我把怀表和他的船钟对好。他答应十一点十六分才掷骰子，掷三次，十七分照点数亮灯。

column5: 船长收起骰子准备驶离
column6: Mid shot at stern: captain closes a small dice pouch and sets shaded handlamp ready, Evan stepping back onto pier at dusk.
column7: 我没给他约任何数，只请他三组之间多停一下，好叫我数得清。船开出去以后，我回到了塔上。

column5: 埃文重启主灯后只留在门侧
column6: Stable lantern-room master; active Fresnel lens at right and clearly separate left threshold with Evan; sea beyond back windows, consistent floor line.
column7: 我重新添油，点起灯，把值班簿带到楼梯门边。只要再等一会儿，我就能知道差的是钟，还是别的东西。我能从这个位置看见透镜，也能越过它，看见窗外那一片海。

column5: 实验前真实海面没有船灯号
column6: Medium over Evan at the left threshold, blank night sea visible through the real window, warm lens off to the right.
column7: 十一点十分，我往窗外看。海上没有信号。照约好的时间，这会儿他手里的骰子都不该拿出来。

column5: 透镜里的窗外抢先闪出灯号
column6: Close Fresnel glass and reflected sea region with clean space for deterministic lamp flashes; outside through real window remains dark, no duplicate ships.
column7: 可透镜里的海面，先亮了。两下，停住。又是五下。最后三下，闪完就看不见了。

column5: 两个埃文一个握笔一个已放下
column6: One real Evan at left still gripping pen, one likeness contained in the right glass with both hands empty, same navy jacket and red scarf; no third Evan.
column7: 玻璃里还有一个我。他把笔搁在值班簿上，抬头看海。我低下头，那支笔分明还攥在我手里。

column5: 埃文当场先把三个点数写下来
column6: Close blank duty log by a closed pocket-watch lid and a laid-down steel nib pen, no hands, allow typographic insert.
column7: 我把数字写了下来，下面划一道线。没有朝船上打灯。那个时候，我也不知道自己写的是不是对的。

column5: 埃文在同一位置等表走
column6: Locked medium from left iron threshold; Evan holds pocket watch low, empty horizon and unchanging window frame, seven-minute ellipsis.
column7: 等的那几分钟，我一直站在同一块地板上。玻璃里的光散了，窗外也还是黑的。我没有碰灯，也没离开门口，怕一挪地方就看不见了。

column5: 真实海面七分钟后出同一灯号
column6: Medium over Evan at the left threshold, blank night sea visible through the real window, warm lens off to the right. Identical framing and figures; offshore flash is a separate deterministic overlay in the real window only.
column7: 十一点十七分，海面上终于亮起手灯。两下。五下。三下。和我刚才记下来的一下不差。

column5: 船钟记录补证点数独立选出
column6: Open ship log beside matching duty entry restaged as desk evidence, two aged pages with typeset areas reserved, no independent scene POV.
column7: 第二天我才拿到船长的记录。他是在十六分掷出的点数。我写下那三个数时，他还没伸手去拿骰子。

column5: 埃文望向曾有自己影像的透镜
column6: No people. Empty real duty ledge with pen now set down, curved lens in the room beyond has no reflected figure, as distinct from the earlier overlap.
column7: 我想起罗斯手里那只杯子。也想起伊恩开门时，楼梯上一个人都没有。人没多，那个来换班的人是先到了。

column5: 埃文按日期重新摊开三本日记
column6: Unoccupied duty desk directly from above, open grey, brown and green books arranged by date, ink bottle holding one page flat, reserve room for accurate later lettering.
column7: 我把三本日记的末页重新排了一遍。有些话我刚翻到时没看懂，譬如罗斯为什么说，他只慢了一步。他们三个都提过灯转过来，可只有读到末页，那行字才有了别的意思。

column5: 罗斯在门边目击伊恩踏入亮带
column6: Wide palely lit lamp room; Ross safely left at threshold, Iain separately at edge of amber strip reaching toward lens at right, no one physically behind the glass.
column7: 伊恩失踪那晚，罗斯也在灯室。他就站在楼梯口，却听见伊恩朝玻璃里喊了一声他的名字。

column5: 伊恩为救玻璃里的人主动前跨
column6: Side middle view of Iain stretching his arm ahead and planting one boot just inside marked moving amber strip, glass face foreshortened.
column7: 伊恩认错了人，以为同伴被困在里面。他跨过去伸手。等那道光扫开，罗斯眼前就没了人。

column5: 伊恩消失后罗斯停在原来的门边
column6: Same side as previous lens angle; Ross still inside door silhouette, now empty strip of light, no extra person beyond the threshold.
column7: 罗斯没追进去。第二天，他还是带着绳子回来了。因为那面玻璃里，伊恩又站在原来的地方。他原本已经下楼了，却又回头看了一眼。那里面的人还没走。

column5: 罗斯系绳安德鲁负责拉人
column6: Medium from far corner; Ross with intact rope loop around waist, Andrew holds the other end from safe left threshold, glass on right.
column7: 他把自己拴上，把另一头给安德鲁。他以为只要有人在外面拉，就能把伊恩一块儿带出来。

column5: 绳索拉回时绳圈已经空了
column6: Detail Andrew glove pulling empty closed rope loop over a worn step in cool shadow, loop unobstructed with no body attached.
column7: 安德鲁写，绳子开始还绷着，突然往回一松。他把绳子全拽了回来，结没有散，里面却是空的。

column5: 安德鲁出发前留最后一页
column6: Wide empty duty room just after Andrew has left; green journal open on worn desk, oil light at right and upward stair visible behind; no figure or readable text.
column7: 最后是安德鲁。他说这次望过去，两个人都在拍玻璃。他在日记里留下这一页，准备再去一次。安德鲁把绳子留在门边。桌上那本绿皮日记，还翻着最后一页。

column5: 安德鲁之后主灯油尽停摆
column6: Empty lantern room in blue-grey dawn, stopped lens and wick with no flame, ordinary fuel container visible and no trace of violence.
column7: 写到这儿就没有了。值班簿也停在同一天。最后一壶灯油烧干，后面没有人再上去添油。

column5: 埃文在玻璃隔面辨认三人
column6: Medium over Evan with three reflected distinct keepers clearly confined to the right glass, one face nearest and two behind; real floor empty.
column7: 当晚下一道灯光扫过来，我终于看全了里面的三张脸。伊恩，罗斯，还有安德鲁。三个人都在那块玻璃后面。

column5: 伊恩从里面敲出换班节奏
column6: Close near glass of Iain's knuckles at the inner surface, refracted glass strips in front of fist, no outside hand, no damage.
column7: 伊恩敲了三下。两下短的，最后一下拖得很长。和第一页写的一样，这是有人来接班的敲法。

column5: 过路船进入礁区外缘
column6: High seaward view through aged glass or from seaward railing; one approaching steamer near dark reef line, supply vessel still separate farther left.
column7: 就在这时，我看见礁石外有条船过来。那是船长说的那一条，灯照过海面，它才看得清自己在哪儿。

column5: 埃文用手灯发出约定引航信号
column6: Medium Evan at sheltered window on safe side, side-on navy jacket, raising small shuttered handlamp angled seaward, not crossing strip.
column7: 我先拿手灯给船长打了约好的信号。过了一会儿，外海那艘补给船转过船头，靠了过去。

column5: 补给船和过路船安全绕开礁线
column6: Wide oblique sea view, supply boat in front, other steamer following at a safe lateral separation beyond reef line, far from rocks.
column7: 它一直走在那条船前面，两个灯从礁石外侧穿过去，慢慢拉开。我看见最后一个灯也出了那片水。

column5: 船安全后埃文把绳圈套到腰间
column6: Medium safe left threshold; Evan holds loop already over waist, separate amber strip to right, three faces only as distant suggestion in the lens.
column7: 我回到门边，把安德鲁留下的绳圈套在腰上。只要再等灯转过来，我也可以到玻璃前面试一次。三个人里总得有一个能出来说清楚，我当时是这么想的。

column5: 触到原来的结后埃文松绳
column6: Close navy-sleeved hands loosening intact figure-like knot at waist, amber edge falls beyond hands; use empty closed loop geometry from S43.
column7: 我的手碰到那个没解开的结。罗斯当时就是这么套的。外面有人拉着，也只拉回来一根空绳。

column5: 埃文留在门侧关闭遮光板
column6: Profile medium; Evan stays left of threshold and pulls lamp shutter lever from cold shadow, warm strip narrowing to right, no reach into beam.
column7: 我把绳子从腰上放下来。没人再来拉我了。我没往前走，伸手够到门旁的拉杆，把灯关了。我一只手够得到拉杆，另一只手还搭在门框上。

column5: 三张脸随主灯熄灭后不再可见
column6: Matched full lamp-room master, extinguished wick, glass empty of people, soft moonlight retains detail, no black scene.
column7: 那只手刚刚还贴在玻璃上。从灯暗下去那一刻起，透镜后面只剩下海。再后来，连海也看不清了。

column5: 埃文锁住转动机构离开
column6: Medium at accessible engaged lock near stair with stopped brass gearing, folded shelf blanket in foreground; lamp off and daybreak, no people.
column7: 我锁住转灯的机构，把值班簿收好，又回值班室拿了那三本日记。

column5: 埃文在天亮后带着记录登船
column6: Wide pale daybreak boat approaches worn landing; Evan boards with bundle under arm and captain waits above, motion clear in static form.
column7: 补给船天亮才靠回栈桥。船长从船上望了望塔，帮我把本子接过去。我请他把自己的记录也带上。

column5: 船上埃文把三本日记按顺序叠好
column6: Wide from cabin entrance with rubbed jamb foreground; Evan small at back-side scratched table with dark brass porthole and three closed journals on table.
column7: 我坐在船舱里，把伊恩的放最下面，再放罗斯的，最后是安德鲁的。我把自己的本子在旁边摊开。到船离开时，我还能从舷窗看见塔。日记的封皮上，全是被人捏出来的旧印子。

column5: 埃文亲手写下带日期的最后一页
column6: Close final journal on rough oak cabin tabletop with empty space for date and single Chinese handwritten conclusion; Evan's own nib held in his hand.
column7: 我熄了灯。他们还在等人接班。
